dataset: Hand Gesture Accelerometer and Gyroscope Dataset (HGAG-DATA), version 3
selected_model_selection_rule: macro-F1 within 0.005 of best validation score, then lowest measured Colab CPU TFLite p95 latency
tflite_input_contract: one raw six-axis window shaped [1, 200, 6]; accel x/y/z then gyro x/y/z
sampling_rate_warning: The model was trained on HGAG recordings at 200 Hz. Verify the Galaxy Watch 5 Pro event timestamps and sensor units. Resampling lower-rate watch data to 200 points does not recreate missing high-frequency signal information.
domain_gap_warning: The research sensor and the watch sensor differ. The HGAG paper describes a 30–90 Hz bandpass. Validate using labelled data recorded on the target watch before relying on predictions.
